artist: Warren LeMay from Chicago, IL, United States
description: Built in 2002-2004, this Contemporary building was designed by Martin Felsen and Sarah Dunn to serve as their personal residence, as well as the home of their architecture and design firm, Urban Lab.  The building consists of a one-story front wing, containing an architecture studio, with a principal facade clad in rusted cor-ten steel panels with perforated metal screens at the windows, corrugated metal panels on the side and rear facades, and a second-story wing that cantilevers onto a grassy mound in the rear, which is clad in metal panels with large bays and exposed steel cross-bracing.  The building is one of the most architecturally significant early 20th Century residences in the city of Chicago, and is an excellent example of the live-work mixed-use housing typology.
